description: Anna Haensch at the University of Wisconsin–Madison publishes a map and underlying inventory of Wisconsin data centres. Zenodo archives version 1.0.0 under MIT and links the public repository. The map distinguishes operational, under-construction, planned and cancelled facilities, geocoded from public sources. The repository README also names county boundaries, transmission-line data, water features and county moratoria used as context layers. Modellers can use the facility inventory to frame regional electricity, water or land-use demand scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Wisconsin status inventory. Coverage is one state and the public sources checked by the author, not a certified utility interconnection register. A limitation is that manually assembled facility status can lag announcements and cancellations; planned facilities should not be counted as operating loads. Third-party base layers retain their own source terms. The map was not recomputed and no facility count or coordinate was independently checked.
